# An agent step edits a file in its work folder. The fake claude refuses the Write unless the start arguments hold
# --permission-mode acceptEdits, as the real claude does in print mode, so the file exists only when the adapter passes the mode.
cp flow/edit.star edit-file
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/edit.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
exists edited.txt
! exists refused.log

-- flow/edit.star --
def main(item):
    agent(name = "implement", prompt = "prompts/implement.md", model = "sonnet")
